title: Preface
summary: The partial document is a table of contents for the 2025 annual report of Weingut Moselhang. It covers several main points including an introduction to the winery, details on vineyards and grape varieties, a summary for 2025, cellar and expansion information, marketing strategies, and planned events.

title: Das Weingut
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
- The Weingut Moselhang has been in family ownership since 1683.
- It manages 11 hectares of vineyard on steep and flat terrains near Kinheim-Brück.
- The estate has been working according to controlled organic guidelines since 2014 and is certified organic since 2019.
- The cellars under the manor house partly date back to the 18th century.

title: Lagen und Rebsorten
summary:
The partial document covers the types and distribution of grape varieties, soil incline, and specific vineyard locations. Main points include:
- Grape varieties: Riesling (74%), Elbling (12%), Spätburgunder (9%), and other varieties (5%)
- Approximately 55% of the vineyard area is steep
- The top vineyard location is the Sonnenuhr-Hang with over 60 years old vines
- Spätlesen and Grosses Gewächs are harvested there, while the rest of the area produces Gutsweine

title: Lese 2025
summary: The partial document covers the Lese 2025 harvest, which took place from September 29 to October 24. It mentions that 58,000 liters of must were delivered with an average must weight of 88 degrees Oechsle. The Late Burgundy variety was harvested on October 6 and fermented in open oak barrels. The healthy harvest allowed for dry late harvest wine production for the first time since 2021.

title: Keller und Ausbau
summary: The partial document discusses the expansion of wine production facilities, primarily using steel tanks. It mentions the use of 380 pieces of 1,000-liter oak barrels for certain late harvested Pinot Noir and some Riesling grape parcels. The fermentation temperature is maintained at 16 degrees Celsius. The wine filling process does not involve fining but includes light filtration. The residual sugar content of the dry wines is below six grams per liter.

title: Vermarktung
summary: The partial document covers the marketing of wines, specifically the sales volumes for 2025 and the average on-farm prices. It states that about 60% of the wines are sold directly from the farm, while the remaining sales are distributed among specialized retailers and restaurants in four federal states. Additionally, a customer in Denmark has been purchasing a fixed annual volume of wine since 2024. The document also includes a table showing the sales volumes and prices for different types of wine in 2025, including Riesling, Elbling, and Spätburgunder.

title: Veranstaltungen
summary: The partial document covers events hosted at a property, including two Harvest Festivals in May and August with a total of 1,600 attendees, wine seminars in the vaulted cellar with 340 participants, and a first-ever autumn hike with a reading breakfast that was fully booked within a week. It also mentions that the next Harvest Festival is scheduled for May 2026.
